title: Conjecture on polynomial-time enumeration of regular graphs
statement:
Fix $k
greater than or equal to 1$ and let $a_n$ be the number of unlabeled $k$-regular graphs with $n$ vertices.

**Regular-graph enumeration conjecture.** The sequence $a_n$ can be computed in polynomial time in $n$.

The source notes polynomial recurrences for labeled $k$-regular graphs for each fixed $k$, but does not establish the corresponding claim for unlabeled graphs. No resolution is supplied.
source_name: Igor Pak, “Complexity problems in enumerative combinatorics”, arXiv:1803.06636 (2018).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.06636

Status: **open** according to the source (as of March 2018). “Here are some of our favorite open problems along these lines, unapproachable with existing tools.”
